description: Create many editable short links and QR codes in one call. Requires Scan Pass or Business. Each item becomes an editable code the user can later change with update_dynamic_qr. Use this for a list of destinations (menus, seats, SKUs). Use create_dynamic_qr for a single editable code, create_fixed_link for non-editable hosted links, and import_bitly_csv for a Bitly CSV. `items` is the array of destinations (and optional titles/slugs). `idempotencyKey` prevents a duplicate batch on retry.

idempotencyKey.description: Prevents duplicate creates or updates on retry (max 64 characters)

customSlug.description: Optional custom short-link slug if the plan allows it

name: bulk_create_dynamic_qrs
title: Make codes in bulk
